review_candidates.description_excerpt: The L3 System Engineer is responsible for providing advanced technical support, troubleshooting, administration, and engineering of enterprise server, virtualisation, storage, backup, and compute infrastructure. Key Responsibilities 1. - Troubleshoot complex server, virtualisation, storage, backup, and compute issues. - Lead troubleshooting for major incidents and critical infrastructure outages. VMware Virtualisation - Administer and troubleshoot enterprise VMware vSphere, ESXi and vCenter envi

You'll grow through hands-on experience with the world's leading technology partners, supported by investment in certifications, consulting capability, and cross-border opportunity.
